headline: BC COPPER-GOLD PORPHYRY NAILS 154m AT 1.21% CuEq FROM SURFACE — American Eagle Opens 50,000m Season at NAK (TSXV:AE)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / American Eagle Gold Corp.
snippet: American Eagle Gold Corp. (TSXV: AE) opened its 2026 drill season at the NAK copper-gold porphyry in British Columbia's Babine district with hole NAK26-83 returning 154 metres of 1.21% CuEq within a broader 280 metres of 0.96% CuEq, plus a site-scale intersection of over 800 metres at 0.49% CuEq from surface — extending the South Zone high-grade core 100 metres to the north. NAK26-83 is the first of approximately 80 planned holes in a fully funded 50,000-metre 2026 campaign, the largest exploration program in American Eagle's history and one of the largest copper-gold drill programs currently underway in British Columbia.

headline: GREENLAND PALLADIUM RESOURCE JUMPS 31% TO 15 Moz PdEq — Grade Surges 44%; S-K 1300 Clears Path to Initial Assessment (NASDAQ:GRML)
snippet: Greenland Mines Ltd. (NASDAQ: GRML) released an updated MRE for its Skaergaard gold-palladium-platinum project in Greenland showing a 31% increase in Indicated PdEq contained metal to 15.00 Moz (from 11.41 Moz), with grade climbing 36–44% to 3.04 g/t PdEq Indicated and 3.07 g/t Inferred after replacing the flat-panel Deswik model with a methodology better suited to Skaergaard's bowl-shaped deposit geometry. The first-ever S-K 1300-compliant report unlocks the path to an Initial Assessment examining open-pit and underground scenarios — arriving as Trump's renewed Greenland campaign at the NATO Ankara summit keeps strategic-metals investors focused on the island's undeveloped deposit base.

headline: FINNISS RESTART OPERATIONAL — Core Lithium Mining at Grants, BP33 Underground Under Contract; $181.8M Cash, First Product Dec 2026 (ASX:CXO)
snippet: Core Lithium (ASX: CXO) reported that its Finniss lithium project in the Northern Territory is now actively producing: open-pit mining at Grants commenced in May under an 11-month NRW contract, and underground decline development at BP33 began following a three-year A$274 million contract award to Develop Global — with first ore from BP33 targeted for mid-2027 and steady-state underground production for mid-2028. The company ended June quarter with $181.8 million cash (up from $91.6M), first product shipment is targeted for December 2026 quarter, making Finniss one of the few idled lithium projects now delivering actual production.

headline: GR SILVER PUSHES SAN MARCIAL 150m SOUTHEAST — 21.9m AT 168 g/t Ag Incl. 6.15m AT 447 g/t Ag Beyond 2023 Resource (TSXV:GRSL)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / GR Silver Mining
snippet: GR Silver Mining (TSXV: GRSL) confirmed the SE Extension target at its San Marcial project in Sinaloa, Mexico extends at least 150 metres southeast of the 2023 NI 43-101 resource boundary, with 21.9 metres at 168 g/t silver including a high-grade core of 6.15 metres at 447 g/t silver. Results are from the company's 20,000-metre step-out campaign targeting resource enlargement across the deposit, with multiple drill rigs active and additional assays pending.

headline: WEST POINT GOLD DRIVES TYRO ZONE TO 350m DEPTH — 51.9m AT 2.5 g/t Au Incl. 21.4m AT 4.72 g/t Au; Maiden Resource Coming (TSXV:WPG)
snippet: West Point Gold Corp. (TSXV: WPG) released assay results from five new holes at the Northeast Tyro zone of its Gold Chain Project in Arizona, with hole GC26-169 intersecting 51.9 metres at 2.5 g/t gold from 276 metres depth — including 21.4 metres at 4.72 g/t gold — tracing high-grade mineralization to approximately 350 metres below surface where the zone remains open. All NE Tyro and Tyro Main results will feed into a maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate targeted for later in 2026.

headline: MEXICO GREENLIGHTS GUITARRA EAST DISTRICT — Sierra Madre Wins 30,000m Drill Permit; 30 Vein Systems, 22 Pads, 60-Day Start (TSXV:SM)
source_name: Investing News Network / Sierra Madre Gold and Silver
snippet: Sierra Madre Gold and Silver Ltd. (TSXV: SM) received SEMARNAT approval for the East District of its Guitarra Mine complex in Temascaltepec, Mexico — covering 22 drill pads positioned to test up to 30 mapped silver-gold vein systems in the first phase of a fully budgeted 30,000-metre program. Initial drilling commences within 60 days from the Tlacotal area, where Sierra Madre holds surface ownership and existing mining activity permits, marking a significant step toward testing the full scale of the Guitarra epithermal system.

headline: FIRST URANIUM DRILL AT CORVO IN 40 YEARS — All 9 Saskatchewan Holes Return Anomalous U, Boron, REE Pathfinders (Aventis Energy)
snippet: Aventis Energy Inc. confirmed anomalous uranium enrichment in all nine completed holes of its inaugural 2,457-metre winter program at the Corvo Uranium Project in northeastern Saskatchewan — the first drilling on the project in over 40 years — with anomalous uranium, boron, and other pathfinder elements confirming a basement-hosted uranium system across three target areas (Manhattan, Brooklyn, and Tribeca). Drill hole CRV-26-009 additionally returned elevated Total Rare Earth Oxide concentrations above 0.1%, adding a REE dimension to a project now confirmed fertile for uranium across its full footprint.

headline: PERU'S FIRST ALKALINE EPITHERMAL FILES FOR DRILL PERMIT — Hannan Targets 7,650m at Previsto; Rock Grades to 33.1 g/t Au (TSXV:HAN)
source_name: Investing News Network / Hannan Metals Ltd.
snippet: Hannan Metals Ltd. (TSXV: HAN) submitted its Declaración de Impacto Ambiental to drill Peru's first documented alkaline epithermal gold-copper system at the Previsto district of its Amanecer project in Puno — a deposit class that includes Cripple Creek, Porgera, and Muruntau among the world's largest gold mines — covering 18 drill platforms and 7,650 metres targeting zones where surface sampling has returned up to 33.1 g/t gold and 120 g/t silver. Community approval is on record and DIA approval is anticipated in Q1 2027.

headline: GOLDSEEK: IRAN CEASEFIRE IMPLOSION SENT GDX DOWN 3.7% — Gold Floor at $3,830; Copper Propping the Metals Complex for Now
snippet: GoldSeek's July 15 Asian Metals Market Update notes Trump's fragile Iran ceasefire imploding this week triggered a disproportionate selloff in gold mining equities — GDX fell 3.7% and 3.0% on back-to-back sessions versus gold's milder 1.2% and 0.8% declines, which the analysis calls 'unjustified selling way overdone.' Technically, gold must hold the $3,830 floor or break $4,260 by the first week of August for the next leg higher; non-ferrous metals including copper and zinc continue to underpin the precious metals complex and have so far prevented a deeper correction despite persistent Iran-driven oil and rate-hike pressure.
